verdict.rationale: Bolt can create a GitHub repository from a project and sync commits, so the code lives outside Bolt and could be deployed elsewhere. A community report also describes a Bolt app launched on Vercel with components deployed to Netlify, which shows external hosting does happen in practice. The documented hosting path, however, is Bolt's own bolt.host, and the generic 'deploy to production from chat' claim does not name an external target. Missing for 10: first-party docs for deploying to external hosts (e.g. Netlify/Vercel) or self-hosted infrastructure, a documented export/download or build-output workflow, and clean hands-on corroboration of external deployment.
